# Bold Shift Advisory

> Interview preparation for individuals and practical workplace training for organizations in Malaysia, founded by Ferhan Johar (15+ years in MNC banking and regional corporate operations: leading teams, hiring, developing people). Company: Bold Shift Advisory Sdn Bhd. Contact: ferhanjohar@boldshiftadvisory.com.

## For individuals
- [Interview Ready Guide](https://boldshiftadvisory.com/interviewprepared): 61-page PDF, RM20, emailed after payment.
- [Resume Review & Editing](https://boldshiftadvisory.com/resume-review): RM59, one target role, edited Word + PDF by email, guide included.
- [Personal Interview Coaching](https://boldshiftadvisory.com/coaching): by enquiry.
- [Free tools](https://boldshiftadvisory.com/free-tools): interview checklist + Interview Companion, free, no account, data stays in the browser.

## For organizations
- [Corporate training](https://boldshiftadvisory.com/corporate-training): communication, judgment and ownership at work. Programs in development. HRDC accreditation in progress (not yet claimable).
